info.title: Mock LMS Issued Badge (signed OBv3 credential)

IssuedBadge.description: A signed Open Badges v3 / W3C Verifiable Credential returned by the LearnCard issuer adapter after the issuer_payload transformation phase. Passed as-is to the wallet_payload transformation phase as the primary source payload.

@context.description: JSON-LD context URLs establishing the credential vocabulary (OBv3 + W3C VC).

type.description: Credential type array; must include VerifiableCredential and OpenBadgeCredential.

issuer.description: DID of the issuing institution. Matches the issuer_id from the profile_resolution source.

issuanceDate.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the credential was issued.

credentialSubject.description: The subject of the credential (the learner) and their achievement.

id.description: DID of the credential recipient. Matches recipient_did from profile_resolution.

achievement.description: The Open Badge achievement definition embedded in the credential.

proof.description: Cryptographic proof applied by the issuer (e.g. DataIntegrityProof).

verificationMethod.description: The key or method used to create the proof.
